name: Zalamea la Real (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a yellow cross set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Zalamea la Real (a column between the letters Z and L on red).
history: Municipal flag of Zalamea la Real; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Zalamea la Real arms — column between the letters Z and L on red
